articles.title: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
articles.description: The long-anticipated exit of the commissioner sometimes known as Crypto Mom is Oct. 2, announced as the agency was sending out its latest crypto work.

articles.title: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations
articles.description: A Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals panel ruled that prediction markets' sports-related events contracts are not swaps, and therefore aren't subject to federal regulatory oversight.

articles.title: Blockchain Association sees leadership shift shortly after crypto Clarity Act fizzles
articles.description: The trade group will be run again by its original CEO, Kristin Smith, when Summer Mersinger leaves at the end of a long congressional tussle.

articles.title: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist
articles.description: The stablecoin issuer blacklisted a wallet holding about $318,000 in USDT and USDC. Most of the stolen funds sit in ether, which can't be frozen.

articles.title: Tokenization is moving faster than Washington
articles.description: Regulatory clarity is not simply a legal or political issue, argues former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo. It is an economic one.

articles.title: Tether confirms minimal EQIBank exposure following $89M US asset seizure
articles.description: While Tether's stated ceiling places its maximum exposure under $64 million, the incident underscores lingering counterparty risks in fiat gateway networks.

articles.title: Strategy proposes daily dividends to bring STRC back toward $100
articles.description: STRC has remained below $100 since May, despite a 12% dividend rate and roughly $1 billion in preferred share buybacks.

articles.title: Bond volatility surges while bitcoin and Wall Street stay calm
articles.description: Bond volatility is at its highest since March, while the bitcoin VIX, BVIV and Wall Street's VIX remain near its yearly low.

articles.title: Bitcoin holders are cashing out, just not the way they did at prior market tops
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 25, 2026

articles.title: Altcoins rally across the board as bitcoin consolidates near $84,000
articles.description: Quant jumped 39% over 24 hours and 93 of 100 CoinDesk 100 constituents rose, with the altcoin season index at its highest in more than three months.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF flows turn positive for 2026 after erasing $5.8 billion deficit
articles.description: At one point in July, ETFs were down $5.8 billion in net outflows for the year. Now, that’s turned into $800 million in net inflows.

articles.title: KelpDAO sues LayerZero for the largest exploit 2026 has seen so far
articles.description: The cross-chain lending protocol accused LayerZero and its co-founder Brian Pellegrino of failing to disclose weaknesses in their protocol, which led to the $292 million hack.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin moves to $84,000, oil slides on latest report of Middle East progress
articles.description: Separate reports from Axios and CBS suggest some positive movement in U.S.-Iran negotiations.

articles.title: Bitget's $352 million hack happened via spoofed transfers, not private keys, CEO Gracy Chen says
articles.description: Bitget lost $351.6 million after attackers compromised a wallet backend, spoofed transaction data, Chen said on X.

articles.title: New York sues Polymarket, alleging it is running an illegal gambling operation
articles.description: The state wants to block Polymarket from operating without a gambling license and recover allegedly illegal gains.

articles.title: U.S. Federal Reserve moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
articles.description: The Fed proposed rules on putting last year's GENIUS Act into place with regulations, including those governing stablecoin yield programs.

articles.title: Crypto exchange Bitget says $352 million affected in a hack, claims user funds are 'safe'
articles.description: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen announced the hack shortly after independent researchers flagged unusual wallet movements.

articles.title: Someone was trying to sell Ondo Finance after founder Nathan Allman's death
articles.description: The company has vehemently denied that it was shopping for buyers. Allman’s estate declined to comment.

articles.title: Bullish, Alpaca, Apex Fintech and DriveWealth form coalition to push issuer-backed tokenized stocks
articles.description: The group aims to link onchain shares to official shareholder records following the U.S. SEC's innovation exemption for tokenized stock trading.

articles.title: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC
articles.description: The U.S derivatives regulator is grinding away at further guidance that welcomes tokenization and blockchain recordkeeping as regular industry elements.

articles.title: The stock token debate, and the gap nobody can close alone
articles.description: The argument over Robinhood’s AMC token has been about which tokenization model is legitimate, and the SEC has drawn a line. The question to ask now is what has to be true for any of it to be a market, argues Bullish’s Tram Doman.

articles.title: Bitcoin just topped a key long-term moving average. Here's what it might mean
articles.description: Bitcoin’s return above its one-year average excited chart watchers. AltcoinPro Research says the more important signal is whether it can stay above its 200-day average.

articles.title: Crypto casino Duelbits goes offline after $7 million hot wallet hack
articles.description: Attackers drained Duelbits' hot wallets across four blockchains; about $6 million in stolen funds now sits in a single Ethereum address.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s bear markets are getting milder. Bull markets may be next
articles.description: Bitcoin’s latest bear market was milder than past crashes as ETFs, institutional investors and a maturing market reshape its cycles.

articles.title: UK’s largest banks complete world’s first interbank transactions using tokenized deposits
articles.description: Barclays, NatWest, and HSBC and others used tokenized deposits for remortgages and a marketplace-payment test, taking bank-issued digital cash beyond a single institution.
